phases.objective: Expose an Admin-only repository-automation controller that reads the current main policy, produces an exact deterministic no-bypass Ruleset plan, and fails closed before any apply unless current-main CAS, finalizer App identity, capability envelope, typed confirmation, exact checks, and same-cycle readback are all proven.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Readback and plan remain non-mutating; a mocked exact apply creates or updates one no-bypass main Ruleset only after all authorization and CAS preconditions pass, proves the same policy fingerprint in same-cycle readback, and rolls back when postconditions do not match.
steps: Read repository metadata, main identity, active rules, Rulesets, Classic Branch Protection, collaborator permissions, auto-merge posture, and configured finalizer App identity.
Report zero or inaccessible protection state as incomplete without mutation.

Build one deterministic main Ruleset requiring pull requests, one approval, stale-review dismissal, conversation resolution, newest-push approval, six canonical checks, strict status checks, non-fast-forward protection, and zero bypass actors.
Require Admin caller, valid capability envelope, exact expected main SHA, exact policy fingerprint, and typed confirmation before mutation.
Create or update only the managed Ruleset and perform immediate bounded readback.
Regenerate operation governance, Frontend dispatch, and runtime-route OpenAPI evidence from the synchronized repository authority.
Rollback or fail closed when the observed policy fingerprint, main identity, no-bypass posture, or server policy gate is incomplete.
assertions: Zero rules and an unprotected main report server_policy_gate_complete=false without mutation.
HTTP 403 or unknown protection state blocks apply.
Stale expected main SHA blocks before mutation.
Missing or invalid capability envelope blocks before network mutation.
Plan output includes capability_authorization bound to the exact repository URI, current main SHA, policy fingerprint, binding hash, and secrets_included=false.
Typed confirmation is mandatory and is never invented by repository automation.
Any bypass actor blocks apply, including the finalizer App.
Review count below one, disabled stale dismissal or conversation resolution, missing exact checks, direct pushes, auto-merge, or merge queue are rejected.
The exact plan applies once under mocked GitHub responses and same-cycle readback matches the desired fingerprint.
Post-readback mismatch triggers rollback evidence and fails closed.
Committed Frontend operation-governance, dispatch, and runtime-route artifacts match the canonical generator output for the synchronized main baseline.
No token, private key, capability secret, provider credential, or raw authorization value appears in response or audit evidence.
The implementation journey performs no live GitHub policy mutation.
Rulesets that explicitly or by pattern exclude main are never counted as applying to main.
Missing branch protection booleans, missing repository auto-merge state, malformed indexes, or unreadable Ruleset details keep server_policy_gate_complete=false.
Every Ruleset index entry must expose a valid numeric ID and a successful detail readback before no-bypass posture can be proven.
Managed Ruleset ambiguity counts active and inactive matching Rulesets before any apply.
A matching Ruleset inherited from an Organization or Enterprise is reported but never treated as repository-owned, updated, rolled back, or accepted as the post-apply managed Ruleset.

phases.objective: After separate authorization, execute one bounded live readback and policy apply against current main, then publish canonical Artifact evidence with server_policy_gate_complete=true.
Prove transport ambiguity recovery, update rollback, ruleset drift handling, and equivalent controls across supported merge paths.
Repository policy administration has no Tenant or provider canary authority.
This implementation grants no Production, Hostinger, deployment, provider, database, migration apply, credential disclosure, protected-ref content write, or external-send authority.
